releaseNotes: First launch: create a new local Git repository with a project name and native parent-folder picker, or open an existing checkout.
New repositories open directly in Creation without a remote, scaffold, initial commit or automatic provider execution.
Software factory candidate: choose Creation or the existing Review workspace.
Plan requirements, architecture and tasks with local-only supporting artifacts outside the checkout.
Queue immutable task-by-task code reviews with app-owned verification evidence and bounded execution loops.
Portable workflow skills and capability-gated provider adapters; unsupported toolchains and approvals remain explicitly blocked.
